pages.text: Free-bound relics work for anyone, Branded or not.
When a hit would leave you at $(l)3 hearts or less$(), that hit is reduced and you gain brief Resistance. Cooldown: $(l)60s$().
Removes $(l)Blindness$() and $(l)Darkness$(), and reveals nearby invisible creatures.
Burning enemies take $(l)20% more damage$() and are repeatedly revealed.
On kill, restore some food, saturation, and health.
